title: ModelBlaster: learning-augmented agents across models, kernels and hardware backends
org: Shengjun Kris Dong, Christos Kozyrakis et al.
gist: An agent whose policy is a persistent knowledge base, updated from textual feedback as it works instead of by retraining. Knowledge learned optimising single kernels is reused for whole-model decisions, across a datacenter GPU, a phone GPU and a RISC-V vector chip.
changes: The only result so far of agent-written kernels on edge-class chips, where it beats the vendor's own SDK. It also bets the opposite way from Together on whether accumulated knowledge helps.
caveats: Two weeks old. The abstract does not name the edge devices or the benchmark suite. Its datacenter results are on the benchmark shown to overstate.

numbers.value: 5.8x over the vendor SDK; 1.7x over Apache TVM

bears_on.note: The agent's policy is a knowledge base that updates as it works.
The same agent produced different winning kernels for a datacenter GPU, a phone GPU and a RISC-V chip.
